evidence.fact: An authorized operator entered one command input incorrectly, removing substantially more servers than intended and taking index and placement subsystems offline.
Large subsystems required full restart and integrity validation; dependent services accumulated additional recovery work.
AWS changed the tool to remove capacity more slowly and to refuse removal below each subsystem's minimum required capacity, and prioritized smaller failure cells.
The health-dashboard administration console depended on S3 and could not update during the outage; it was moved across multiple regions.

observedFailure: A legitimate maintenance command accepted a scope error that crossed subsystem minimum-capacity boundaries before the system could recover.
